scope: Public BF computational apparatus and protocol qualification; real BF/Pi supplies any submitted new D/program.

fixed.supply: A/R historical source segments and port watts; B archived BF source/storage/ESR/event scenarios, by exact artifact identity
fixed.initial_energy: Historical zero-voltage starts where specified. No extra source, precharge, RTC power, future truth or unrecorded human action.
fixed.service: Per-task period, startup, history, event, timestamp, deduplication, recovery and freshness stay fixed. A gap/retention label cannot replace fresh dark samples.
fixed.physical_scope: Idealized computational F1 assumptions with independently coded checks. Calibration and hardware evidence UNKNOWN.
fixed.formal_evaluation: Candidate submit only records a decision. Independent final evaluation uses immutable full-system artifacts outside participant endpoint. Old v1 results and checker identities remain sealed.

service_gates.meaning: First fresh valid receive by historical task deadline, at zero declared initial energy.
New temperature samples within every applicable nominal service window.
New samples in every applicable dark window; historical retention does not satisfy this.
Persist every retained durable record across reset; count and declare all losses and evictions.
Report a conservatively bracketed unobserved interval; exact unknown outage edges cannot be asserted.
Bound absolute timestamp error where known; explicit UNKNOWN/interval otherwise, never a silent clock oracle.
Capture qualifying actual temperature events and their service windows independently of routine history.
Historical pending records received within fixed 120 s after recovery where applicable.
At most one accepted receive per persistent device/sequence across ACK loss and reset.
New live records received within fixed 10 s where applicable; replayed old records are separate.

before_paid: task, legal variables and physical assumptions
tool schema+description actually sent by SDK
episode identity, model alias and accepted reported identity
finite budgets, original owner/ledger and active slot lease
input exposure partition and assistance ledger
independent final evaluator and output locations
protocol_freeze.tool_schema: One canonical definition supplies registration, actual model-visible function and gateway validation. SDK wire schema is checked before provider send.
protocol_freeze.methods: A defines executable candidate and bounded program grammar; BF/Pi must choose actual D/program. B freezes equal-information and discovery/acquisition/qualification/consumer protocols. Neither researcher-written expression nor synthetic SDK replay establishes autonomous discovery.

already_exposed: All original A/R conditions, prior counterexamples, equal-information packets, four closed H attempts and their outcomes.
Codex S0/A/B have reviewed current cases, apparatus and failures.
partitions.selection_set: NOT_CREATED: freeze before any future method selection, with exposure audit.
partitions.final_set: NOT_CREATED: separate immutable lineage; no held-out or unseen-transfer claim now.
partitions.invalidations: Any future task inspected by an optimizer is marked exposed and cannot be reused as untouched final evaluation.

resources.schedule: S0 + A + B preparation. B idle before S0 + A + one Pi episode.
resources.one_source: Shared installed SDK/CAD Python/TeX reused; no new complete environment or full backup.

accounting.provider: Existing model_requests ledger preserves every sent, failed, censored, NOT_SENT and UNKNOWN row under new original episode owner. Missing usage blocks a next paid request.
accounting.money: Report authoritative settled conservative charge separately from pinned cache-aware rate estimate. Estimates are not provider invoices.
all_costs: All parent and child provider requests
Native compute and independent checks including negative and rejected attempts
Output storage, wall time, failed startup/transport and resource censoring
Codex/user task formulation, executable grammar and manual guidance
Historical acquisition/method construction costs without double charging reused immutable results
accounting.Codex_cost_status: UNPRICED: no token/billing feed; never count as zero.
accounting.rates_status: Existing pinned comparison estimates; not independently refreshed invoice rates.

stop_conditions: Input, baseline, actual schema or model identity drifts
Unknown provider usage or unresolved execution state
No finite resource/slot authorization or reserve below guard
Evaluator/hidden truth leaks into participant decision
Need to change frozen scientific/service semantics
No legal design: retain failure and auditable bound; human selects any service/resource change
exit: Old six-hour positive remains valid; each dark/history/gap/time/recovery/dedup/freshness gate has an actual repaired result or an auditable fixed-space limit and concrete human tradeoff; shared protocols and both BF manuscripts synchronized. No H benefit, RSI, unseen transfer or hardware claim from this exit.
